about: The engine's taps (models/deepseek41/bundle/src/taps.rs and taps/text.rs, built with the diagnostic-taps feature), in program order. The first entry whose name matches applies; {nn} is a two-digit layer.

Names follow tools/refrun/README.md ("Taps and tapdiff"); models/deepseek41/reference.py `taps` maps the same names onto the vendor modules: embed.out the embedding; L<nn>.in.streams the block's four mHC streams; x.hc.attn.{pre,post,comb} and x.hc.ffn.{pre,post,comb} a block's mHC coefficients; x.hc.attn and x.hc.mlp the attn_norm and ffn_norm inputs; attn.in and mlp.in their outputs; x.latent the normalized window latent before RoPE and quantization; attn.out and mlp.out the all-reduced sublayer outputs; router.weights and router.ids the gate's outputs; L<nn>.out the block's output streams; final.x.hc.head the norm's input; final.norm its output.

enc.vision.out is the aligner's output on its image cells in raster order, without the learned start, newline and end rows (reference.py taps the aligner), from rank 0's media arena; enc.vision.B<nn>.out is each vision block's output rows in patch order, read back by the shared encoder runtime, and enc.vision.B<nn>.in a transformer's input rows, written by the engine only.

Every text tap is replicated and written from rank 0 after its stage, for prefill phases only, except the reduction inputs: L<nn>.x.attn.partial and L<nn>.x.mlp.partial are read before their all-reduce's launches, which may round the partial in place, from every rank (rank_partial: the all-reduce sums them in rank order in F32 and rounds once to BF16, or rounds each to BF16 first under the native Flash TP4 prefill's BF16-partial contract). They are detail taps, kept only in the layers CHOPINFER_TAPS_LAYERS names. The text taps' widths follow the geometry, so their entries leave cols out.

KV-state taps (taps/kv.rs) are detail taps too, selected like any tap (for example CHOPINFER_TAPS_LAYERS=all CHOPINFER_TAPS_SITES=x.kv.*); selecting one runs prefills stage by stage, as a text tap does. L<nn>.x.kv.window is layer nn's window ring; L<nn>.x.kv.compressed and L<nn>.x.kv.index are KV source nn's compressed latents and index keys in the serving pages (Flash: sources 2, 8 and 14 at compress ratio 2, source 20 at ratio 1). Each is BF16 [rows, width], width head_dim (512) or index_head_dim (128): the logical value the attention or indexer reads, which is the BF16 layout's stored bytes, or the native layout's code times its block scale decoded exactly by the trained quantizer's shared decoder (kernel_core::quantize::Quantized; window E4M3 with a UE8M0 scale per 32, compressed E2M1 with an E4M3 scale per 16, index E2M1 with a UE8M0 scale per 32). The native layout also writes the stored bytes of each row: <name>.codes and <name>.scales, u32 [rows, bytes / 4] holding the stored bytes in memory order (4 bytes per word; 512 and 16 bytes a window row, 256 and 32 a compressed row, 64 and 4 an index row), so a check can confirm that they decode exactly to the BF16 layout's values. Every rank holds the whole state and writes its own copy: ranks every, file <name>.r<k>.bin for rank k, index.jsonl rank k.

KV steps: capture.json program KvState, one step per readback and row axis, numbered as they are read: a restore readback before its step's text step, a prefill or decode readback after it. The window axis holds every layer's window rows, token positions max(0, end - sliding_window) .. end - 1, each read from its ring cell (position % (sliding_window + 8)). Each compressed axis holds the KV sources of one compress ratio, page groups in declaration order (ratio 2, then 1), compressed positions 0 .. floor(end / ratio) - 1; compressed position c covers tokens c * ratio .. c * ratio + ratio - 1. Within a step entries follow layer, then plane (compressed before index), then part (codes, scales, values; the BF16 layout writes values only), then rank. items.json holds items[0].request and .slot, and kv: phase, axis (window or compressed), ratio (1 on the window axis), storage (native or bf16), end and positions, where positions[r] is row r's position (token positions on the window axis, compressed positions on a compressed axis) and an index entry's rows are rows first_row .. first_row + rows - 1. Phases: prefill, read after each prefill chunk's launches, end = its last row's position + 1; decode, read after each decode step's launches, end = its row's position + 1; restore, read before the first step of a request restored from a prefix hit, end = the restored tokens, holding the restored rings and the shared pages. CHOPINFER_TAPS_FROM=P keeps the rows whose first token is P or later, and CHOPINFER_TAPS_BYTES bounds each step. A cancelled or failed step's KV steps are removed with its other steps.

KV-state coverage left unresolved, written by no tap: verify steps (rows past the committed end, which commit_accepted rolls back); every step of an instance with the DSpark drafter loaded (create logs it; serve with --speculative-tokens 0); ring cells outside the window (the 8 headroom cells and older positions); the ratio-2 compressors' open-group tail (compressor.tail, F32 state); anchor spares and the snapshot pages themselves (a restore readback reads the slot they were copied into); restores from a prompt-end anchor: a tapped instance offers no anchors (prefill_anchor_items is 0), so the host ends a chunk at the prompt's last whole page (a multiple of 64 tokens) to capture it, a tapped server's prefix hits restore only from those committed-chunk-end captures, which the restore readback covers, and the anchor restore path is never run. A native row whose code and scale do not decode exactly to a finite BF16, which no valid store holds, stops its step at that tap, left incomplete, and the server log names its tap, rank and row; nothing is inferred for it.

taps.name: enc.vision.out
taps.layout: hidden; the aligner's image cells on the encoder row axis

taps.name: enc.vision.B{nn}.in
taps.layout: F32 residual stream (f32-pairs.v1); a transformer's input rows; written by the engine only

taps.name: enc.vision.B{nn}.out
taps.layout: F32 residual stream (f32-pairs.v1); a vision block's output rows in patch order

taps.name: L{nn}.x.attn.partial
taps.layout: hidden; this rank's completed local F32 partial of the attention output, before rounding and exchange; one file per rank (.r<k>.bin)

taps.name: L{nn}.router.weights
taps.layout: top-k weights, in the order of router.ids

taps.name: L{nn}.x.mlp.partial
taps.layout: hidden; this rank's completed local F32 partial of the MoE output (routed sum with the shared expert's partial), before rounding and exchange; one file per rank (.r<k>.bin)

taps.name: L{nn}.x.kv.window.codes
taps.layout: native layout only: the stored E4M3 codes, one byte per channel of layer nn's window ring at token positions, row by row, four bytes per u32 in memory order

taps.name: L{nn}.x.kv.window.scales
taps.layout: native layout only: the stored UE8M0 scales, one per 32 channels of layer nn's window ring at token positions, row by row, four bytes per u32 in memory order

taps.name: L{nn}.x.kv.window
taps.layout: head_dim; layer nn's window ring at token positions, as the logical BF16 values the attention reads

taps.name: L{nn}.x.kv.compressed.codes
taps.layout: native layout only: the stored E2M1 codes, two per byte, the even channel in the low nibble of KV source nn's compressed latents in the serving pages at compressed positions, row by row, four bytes per u32 in memory order

taps.name: L{nn}.x.kv.compressed.scales
taps.layout: native layout only: the stored E4M3 scales, one per 16 channels of KV source nn's compressed latents in the serving pages at compressed positions, row by row, four bytes per u32 in memory order

taps.name: L{nn}.x.kv.compressed
taps.layout: head_dim; KV source nn's compressed latents in the serving pages at compressed positions, as the logical BF16 values the attention reads

taps.name: L{nn}.x.kv.index.codes
taps.layout: native layout only: the stored E2M1 codes, two per byte, the even channel in the low nibble of KV source nn's index keys in the serving pages at compressed positions, row by row, four bytes per u32 in memory order

taps.name: L{nn}.x.kv.index.scales
taps.layout: native layout only: the stored UE8M0 scales, one per 32 channels of KV source nn's index keys in the serving pages at compressed positions, row by row, four bytes per u32 in memory order

taps.name: L{nn}.x.kv.index
taps.layout: index_head_dim; KV source nn's index keys in the serving pages at compressed positions, as the logical BF16 values the attention reads
